conditions: Creator gets 55% of net revenue from ads on the watch page (Watch Page Monetization Module). $100 = $100 of net ad revenue attributed to the channel, not a fan payment.

Creator keeps 45% of the Creator Pool revenue allocated to them. Pool share is set after a music-licensing split (a Short with 1 track sends half its revenue to music partners first), so the share of total Shorts-feed revenue can be lower. From 2027-02-01 a new 10M qualified Shorts views per 90 days threshold applies.

Standard 50/50 split on net subscription revenue; net is after taxes and other deductions, so share of gross is 50 or less. Plus Program levels pay 60/40 (100 Plus Points for 3 months) or 70/30 (300 points). Official help article did not render for our fetcher; 50% standard rate quoted from Twitch's own blog.
Standard 10% plan for creator pages published after 2025-08-04 (legacy plans 5/8/11%). One $100 card payment from a US fan, USD payout. Payout fee excluded: $0.25 per direct deposit.
10% Substack fee plus Stripe card processing (US card) and 0.7% Stripe Billing on recurring payments. One $100 web payment; in-app purchase pricing differs.
Terms: Our Fee is 20% of the total Fan Payment. Bank or e-wallet currency/transfer charges excluded.

Standard rate: developer receives 70% of price (minus applicable taxes Apple collects) in a subscriber's first year; rises to 85% after one paid year. Same 30% for paid apps and IAP outside the small business program. Apple collects and remits sales tax.
Reduced 15% rate on paid apps and IAP for developers with up to $1M proceeds in the prior calendar year and current year (including associated accounts). Enrollment required.

US users, new fee schedule effective 2026-06-30: first $1M of annual earnings = 10% service fee + 5% billing fee for all transaction types. Above $1M: auto-renewing subs 10%+5%; other purchases 20%+5% (new installs) or 25%+5% (existing installs).

$100 item, free shipping, sales tax not counted (US: transaction fee excludes tax but processing fee is charged on tax too). $0.20 listing + 6.5% transaction + 3% + $0.25 processing (US Etsy Payments, Etsy Payments Policy snapshot 2026-10-11). Low end of range = sale attributed to Offsite Ads at 15% (shops under $10k/yr; 12% and mandatory above). One-time shop set-up fee may apply (amount not published).
US project, successfully funded, one $100 pledge. Pledges under $10 pay 5% + $0.08 processing. No fees if funding fails.

Sale via your own profile/link: 10% + $0.50 plus card processing 2.9% + $0.30. Low end of range = sale via Gumroad Discover marketplace (flat 30% incl. processing). 5% + $0.50 applies once paid sales pass $20k in a calendar month. Gumroad is merchant of record since 2025-01-01; help page also says fee is charged + sales tax.
Seller earns 80% of the purchase amount including Gig Extras and tips. Buyer separately pays a service fee. Withdrawal fees excluded.

Freelancer Service Fee ranges 0% to 15% per contract and is fixed once the contract starts. kept_from_100 shows the worst case (15%); the fee for a given job is shown before you bid. Withdrawal fees and Connects excluded.

Left blank: Uber does not publish an average driver share of the fare. It says its US average revenue per trip (take rate) is around 20% after adjusting for insurance costs; insurance alone was 14-31% of an average fare in the states it listed (Dec 2025), so 80% is not the driver share.

Base 30% is not stated in any public Valve page (it is in the non-public Steam Distribution Agreement); 30% figure from class counsel in Wolfire v. Valve (https://www.quinnemanuel.com/the-firm/news-events/quinn-emanuel-secures-class-certification-seeking-billions-in-damages-for-wolfire-games-and-a-class-of-game-publishers-in-in-wolfire-games-llc-et-al-v-valve-corp-2-21-cv-00563/). Valve's official tiers: 25% on earnings beyond $10M, 20% beyond $50M (https://steamcommunity.com/groups/steamworks/announcements/detail/1697191267930157838). Share applies to net revenue after returns, chargebacks and taxes. $100 Steam Direct fee per app, recouped after $1,000 adjusted gross revenue.
